title: Recipe 61 — Self-building evals for any shape (scaffold, mine, calibrate)

beats.label: Open the recipe
beats.cue: “The reason most agents have no evals is that writing the first one is tedious. This recipe removes that excuse.”

beats.label: Start from a blank spec
beats.cue: live/ is scratch — nothing committed is touched by a take.

beats.label: Load the API key
beats.cue: [needs-key] Sources demos/.env — synthesis and judge calibration are billed.

groups.title: Beat 1 · a spec with no evals

beats.label: Type a harness
beats.cue: “Seven lines and no eval assets whatsoever — the state every real project starts in.”

beats.label: Lint it
beats.cue: “Clean, and completely unmeasured. Those are different things.”

beats.label: Scaffold eval assets from the spec
beats.cue: “It reads the spec and writes a dataset skeleton and a graders file shaped for that target. Day one, from nothing.”

verify.note: writes a starting dataset + graders pair under live/eval

beats.label: List what it wrote
beats.cue: “Two files. Not a framework — two files you can read and edit.”

beats.label: Read the list
beats.cue: “A dataset to grow and a graders file to sharpen. That's the whole starting kit.”

beats.label: Read a template's grader card
beats.cue: “graders card explains what a template actually measures — read it before you trust a score it produces.”

beats.label: Read it
beats.cue: “A grader you can't explain is a number you shouldn't ship on.”

groups.title: Beat 3 · find the gaps, keep it honest

beats.label: Read the coverage contract
beats.cue: “eval coverage compares what your users actually asked against what your dataset covers — the gap is your next test case.”

beats.label: Read it
beats.cue: “Coverage against real traffic, not against your imagination.”

beats.label: Read the dataset-lint contract
beats.cue: “dataset lint catches near-duplicates, leaked answers, and rows whose gold is stale — the quiet ways a dataset rots.”

beats.label: Read it
beats.cue: “--strict for CI. A rotting dataset fails green, which is the worst failure mode there is.”

groups.title: One more thing · grow it and calibrate the judge

beats.label: Mine real sessions into cases
beats.cue: [needs-key] “dataset mine --review turns the turns you actually served into candidate rows, with a human in the loop.”

verify.note: needs session history; the review step needs a human

beats.label: Synthesize variants
beats.cue: [needs-key] “Bounded by --budget-usd, because generating test cases is exactly the loop that runs away.”

verify.note: billed generation; bounded by the budget flag

beats.label: Calibrate the judge
beats.cue: [needs-key] “The judge is a model too. graders test --min-agreement 0.85 is how you find out whether to trust it.”

verify.note: needs golden verdicts and a model credential

beats.label: Read the whole verb map
beats.cue: “scaffold → coverage → lint → mine → synthesize → calibrate. Each one answers a question the previous one raised.”
